LanguageData.Raven_Raven: A composite structure made by mixing molten iron with crushed obsidian, infused with a special alkaline ash from burning wood. This creates a material rich in micro-pores and light-absorbing carbon particles. It is lighter than normal steel and has excellent energy absorption properties.
LanguageData.Raven_CoronaSteel.label: [Raven] Corona Steel
LanguageData.Raven_CoronaSteel.description: A fusion of technology and divinity. It uses Raven Darkfeather Steel as a base, wraps it in molten silver to form energy pathways, and embeds jade as a soul stabilizer. It constantly emits a faint golden glow.
